x: At our open field events meeting only two Bels turned out to compete; Dave Wiseman was 5th in the Lomg Jump 18'6" and H. Leyer 5th in the Javelin with a throw of 161'1".

In the Junior match Dave Wiseman cantered home in the quarter in 52.0 secs. and Jack Hampshire took the half in 2:7.6. Pottinger once again proved himself a mainstay in the field events by taking the long jump and the weight.
Dave Wiseman has already made his mark at the Cambridge University Freshman's Sports and we expect him to claim a place in his University team.
David "Danny" Wiseman died of cancer at the early age of 44 last August. Danny joined the Club in 1954 at the tender age of 9 years.
